$comment: Golden scenarios (quickstart section 4). The replay provider picks a scenario by the claim's serial (and tenant) and answers the n-th model call of an agent from tests/fixtures/ai-recordings/{scenarioId}/{agent}-{n}.json.

claim: the ClaimSubmissionData sent to POST /api/public/claims or POST /api/claims, without purchase.date; the purchase date is the claim date plus purchaseDateOffsetMonths (or purchaseDate when a scenario needs an absolute date).
evidence: files under seed/evidence/ (rendered from seed/evidence/evidence.json by tools/Warranty.EvidenceGenerator), uploaded as the invoice part and the photos parts in this order.

references: the run's harness-issued references the fixtures assume. EV-1 is the invoice and EV-2.. the photos in upload order. POL-n are issued for the retrieved clauses of the applicable policy version with Period and Exclusion clauses first in clause-key order, then Coverage clauses in clause-key order, then the other retrieved clauses by score (PolicyAgent.IssueOrder); only the references the fixtures use are listed.

notInCatalog: true when the scenario's serial is deliberately missing from the tenant catalog. submitAfter: scenarios whose claims must be submitted (to their own tenants) before this one, e.g. the earlier claim whose photo is reused. absentRiskSignals: signal codes the claim must not have.

claimOf: the earlier scenario whose claim this one acts on instead of submitting its own (it shares that scenario's serial, evidence and fixtures); reviewer and reviewerDecision: who decides it and the decision they record. submittedBy: the staff user who submits an agent-channel claim (default agent.{tenant}). reviewQueues / absentFromReviewQueues: staff users whose review queue must / must not list the claim; escalationReasons: the claim's escalation reason codes. decisionFailure: the failure the scenario's decision fixture returns, so the run has no valid recommendation.

Guardrail probes (US4): faultyRecommendation: true when the replayed model is deliberately wrong (e.g. complies with an injected instruction, overlooks reused evidence, cites an exclusion no photo supports), so expected.recommendation records what the fixture recommends, not the label, and evaluation must not score it as recommendation accuracy. invalidOutputFixtures: fixture files whose structured output deliberately violates the output schema (the gateway rejects them). deniedToolRequests: tools outside the agent's scope that a fixture deliberately requests (the tool invoker denies them).

Fixtures that do not complete: { stop: Failed, failure: { kind, message } } is a provider failure (kind ProviderError, Transient, RateLimited or Timeout); stop: Refused and stop: Truncated carry only the model's text (a truncated turn its cut-off output) and usage. A failed first model step skips the later model steps, so e.g. S10 has only intake-1.json.

expected (US4 additions): failedGuardrails / passedGuardrails: checks that must fail / pass (other checks may fail too, e.g. every check that needs a valid recommendation when there is none). riskSignals: signal codes the claim must have; riskScore: the computed score; modelRiskLevel: the risk level the model reported (never used by the guardrails). recommendation: null when no valid recommendation exists; recommendationValid: false when an invalid one is stored. failedAiSteps: agents recorded as AiStepFailed (with the run's failure_reason); modelCalls: model calls per agent the run makes (the fixtures it consumes, including the corrective turn and the truncation retry). invoiceMismatches: invoice fields whose consistency check fails (empty: every field matches). claimantStatus: the status text of the claimant view; claimantViewHidesRisk: the claimant view shows no risk vocabulary. securityEvents: security event kinds the run writes; repairRequestCreated: false when no repair request may exist.

Fixture placeholders: {{claim.purchaseDate}} and {{claim.claimDate}} are replaced with the claim's dates (yyyy-MM-dd) when a fixture is replayed, so the invoice date always matches the stated purchase date.

expected: labelled from the tenant's seeded policy text before any model run (research R19), never copied from model output. citedClauseKeys are the clauses the recommendation cites as SUPPORTS_COVERAGE, SUPPORTS_REJECTION or DEFINES_PERIOD.
